title: The original bounded exchange and its actual three-arrow diagram
statement: For a condensed commutative coefficient ring Lambda and a square of schemes, form its actual ambient exchange diagram from residueExchangeAdjunction and residueExchangeSquare, retaining all four vertices. In the field and separated finite-type context of boundedConstructibleBaseChange, cache its original underlying component at a bounded constructible K with the endpoints of this diagram. The defining equation is reflexivity. The original total equals the diagram composite by the existing bounded-exchange ambient-mate theorem and the generic mate component formula. No properness, Cartesianity, or invertibility hypothesis is added.

proof.text: Construct the ambient diagram directly from the actual residue adjunctions and square. Define the typed total to be precisely the original bounded exchange component; its defining equation is reflexivity.
Use boundedConstructibleBaseChange_hom_eq_ambient for the original total and mate_eq_exchangeChain_composite for the actual mate. Transitivity gives the specified three-arrow factorization.
Unfold only the cached endpoints and their named functors to prove equality of entire Arrow objects with the original bounded exchange arrow; the exchange component itself remains unchanged.
